title: Naousa massacre
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Naousa massacre", at revision 1370629235, opens: "The Massacre of Naoussa or Destruction of Naoussa was a bloody event of the Greek War of Independence that occurred in Naousa, Imathia on 13 April 1822." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3396743, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "bloody event of the Greek War of Independence in 1822". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
